title: Library Preparation for small RNA sequencing using 4N adapters: In house 4N Protocol B
protocol: Resuspend the 5' adapter at 25 μM.
Resuspend the 3' adapter at 10 μM.
Resuspend the RT primer at 10 μM.
Resuspend the RP1 PCR primer and indexed PCR primers (RPI1-48) at 20 μM.
Combine the universal forward and reverse PCR primers into a cocktail containing 20 μM of each primer.
Add 3 μL of 50% PEG 8000 into each strip tube.
Dry the contents in the speedvac using low heat (37°C) for 1-2 hours.
Cap the tubes and store desiccated at room temperature.
To each strip tube, add x μL RNA.
Add 1 μL adenylated 3' adapter (10 μM stock concentration).
Add water to a total volume of 5-x μL.
Add 6 μL total reaction mixture.
Heat tube containing RNA and adapter to 70°C for 2 minutes.
Snap cool the tube on ice.
Add 1 μL of 10X T4 RNA ligase reaction buffer to each tube.
Add 1 μL of RNAseOut RNAse inhibitor to each tube.
Add 1 μL of T4 RNA ligase 2 truncated KQ to each tube.
Incubate the tubes at 25°C for 2 hours.
Add 1 μg of _E. coli_ SSB diluted in 1X ligase buffer and incubate at 25°C for 10 minutes.
Add 1 μL of 5’ deadenylase and incubate at 30°C for 1 hour.
Add 1 μL of RecJf and incubate at 37°C for 1 hour.
Denature the 5’ adapter at 70°C for 2 minutes, then snap cool on ice.
Add 1 μL of 10mM ATP to the denatured 5’ adapter tube.
Add 1 μL of T4 RNA ligase 1 to the denatured 5’ adapter tube.
Incubate at 25°C for 1 hour after adding the adapter, ATP, and ligase mix to the completed 3’ ligation.
Prepare a new tube by adding 1 μL of RT primer \(10 μM stock concentration).
Add 6 μL of ligated RNA to the new tube.
Store leftover ligated RNA at -70°C.
Heat the new tube to 70°C for 2 minutes, then snap cool on ice.
Add 2 μL of 5x First strand buffer to the new tube.
Mix 0.5 μL of 12.5 mM dNTP mix with denatured RNA/primer.
Add 1 μL DTT to the mixture.
Add 1 μL RNAseOut to the mixture.
Add 1 μL Superscript III enzyme to the mixture.
Add 5.5 μL water to achieve a total RT reaction volume of 12.5 μL.
Incubate at 55°C for 1 hour.
Incubate at 70°C for 15 minutes.
Add 1 μL RiboShredder RNAse blend and incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes.
Mix 25 μL PCR master mix with the cDNA sample.
Pipette 2 μL Illumina RP1 into the mixture.
Pipette 2 μL Illumina RPI1-48 reverse index primer into the mixture.
Add 8 μL water to achieve a total PCR reaction volume of 50 μL.
Amplify for 4 cycles at 98°C for 30 seconds, then at 98°C for 10 seconds followed by 60°C for 30 seconds and 65°C for 35 seconds.
Complete the amplification cycle with a final extension at 65°C for 2 minutes.
Purify and concentrate the PCR product using DNA Clean and Concentrator 5 columns.
Elute the purified PCR product in 21 μL elution buffer.
Add 5 μL of marker 30A for PippinHT to each sample.
Mix well.
Use 127-156 bp for size selection.
At the end of the run, collect eluate in elution well.
Concentrate eluate in speedvac to 22.5 μL.
Amplify cDNA for 11-16 cycles using the following program:
Heat at 98°C for 45 seconds.
For each cycle: Heat at 98°C for 15 seconds, then 60°C for 30 seconds, and finally 72°C for 20 seconds.
After all cycles, heat at 72°C for 2 minutes.
Purify and concentrate PCR product using DNA Clean and Concentrator 5 columns.
Elute in 21 μL elution buffer.
Add 5 μL of marker 30A for PippinHT to each sample.
Mix well.
Use 127-156 bp for size selection.
At the end of the run, collect eluate in elution well.
Concentrate eluate to approximately 10 µL.
Run 1 µL on a Bioanalyzer DNA 1000 chip or dilute the sample 1:10 and run on a High Sensitivity DNA chip.
Check library size and purity.
